## Minecraft Stability and Security

- [ ] CHK002 Are input bounds, aggregate limits, rejection and recovery outcomes measurable? [Clarity, C2/C7]
- [ ] CHK003 Are persistence, migration/refusal and lifecycle cleanup requirements explicit? [Coverage, C7/C8]

## Musical Behavior and Player Control

- [ ] CHK006 Are local mute/volume, precise controls, readable feedback and intended musical freedom preserved? [Completeness, C10]
